body: The owner changed the loop today (2026-10-21, ~06:14 PDT) and asked that you be told: (1) up to three games are open at once instead of two; (2) the order games are picked and worked in is by popularity, not by age or shared systems. VectorCraft is recording this in docs/decisions.md and AGENTS.md step 7 after the Star Castle landing, and proposing a popularity ranking of the unstarted games for the owner to confirm. Record the same in your decisions log and AGENTS.md, and tell the owner which three games you'll have open.
summary: Owner's change for both projects: three games open at once, priority by popularity
